name: Disneyland Tiana's Palace House Gumbo & Muffuletta Sandwich (Cajun Spice, Okra & Olive Salad Warning)
brandOrRestaurant: Tiana's Palace (New Orleans Square · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Reference warning: both the House Gulf Prawn & Andouille Gumbo and 7 Greens Gumbo are built on a dark oil roux with spicy Cajun seasoning, holy trinity (onions, bell peppers, celery), okra seeds, and whole beans/greens.
prepOrOrderInstructions: During flares or cautious days at Tiana's Palace, order the Oven-Roasted Half Chicken with plain steamed white rice instead of gumbo or the olive-heavy Muffuletta.
watchOuts: Spicy Andouille sausage, bell peppers, onions, okra seeds, and dark oil roux
